        idents = c("3", "4"),

## DGE CD40 vs Isotype


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
so_b2m <- subset(so %>% set_idents("genotype"), idents = "B2m KO")
so_wt <- subset(so %>% set_idents("genotype"), idents = "Ctrl")
dge_cd40.v.wt_list <- run_or_readRDS(
    file.path(
        results_dir, 
        "DGE_filterRNA200mito10_subsetTremovedoublets_subsetNK_cd40.v.WT.rds"
    ), 
    function() {
        list(
            b2m = FindMarkers(so_b2m %>% set_idents("treatment"), 
                             ident.1 = "CD40 agonist", 
                             ident.2 = "Isotype"), 
            wt = FindMarkers(so_wt %>% set_idents("treatment"), 
                             ident.1 = "CD40 agonist", 
                             ident.2 = "Isotype")
        )
    }
)
dge_cd40.v.wt_df <- bind_rows(
    dge_cd40.v.wt_list$wt %>% as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% mutate(genotype = "WT"), 
    dge_cd40.v.wt_list$b2m %>% as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% mutate(genotype = "B2m KO")
)
```

Using the `ggplotly` function to investigate this scatter plot interactively, I see that a lot of the genes which associate differentially with CD40 in WT or B2m KO are actually ribosomal genes, so maybe that's just due to noise. Let's consider only genes which are enriched in both. 


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
dge_cd40.v.wt_df %>% 
    filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>% 
    pivot_wider(id_cols = gene, 
                names_from = genotype, 
                values_from = c(p_val, avg_log2FC)) %>% 
    filter(avg_log2FC_WT * `avg_log2FC_B2m KO` > 0) %>% 
    mutate(direction = ifelse(`avg_log2FC_B2m KO` > 0, "CD40", "isotype")) %>% 
    group_by(direction) %>% 
    slice_max(abs(`avg_log2FC_B2m KO`), n = 20) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(gene = fct_reorder(gene, `avg_log2FC_B2m KO`)) %>% 
    ggplot() + 
    aes(gene, `avg_log2FC_B2m KO`) + 
    geom_segment(aes(xend = fct_reorder(gene, `avg_log2FC_B2m KO`), 
                     y = 0, yend = `avg_log2FC_B2m KO`)) + 
    geom_text(aes(label = gene, y = 0), hjust = 1.1, size = 3, angle = 90, 
              data = ~..1 %>% filter(`avg_log2FC_B2m KO` > 0)) + 
    geom_text(aes(label = gene, y = 0), hjust = -0.1, size = 3, angle = 90,
              data = ~..1 %>% filter(`avg_log2FC_B2m KO` < 0)) + 
    geom_point(aes(size = -log10(`p_val_B2m KO`))) + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), 
          axis.line.x = element_blank())
```
